tree.heading: In general
tree.text: A partnership may file a request for an administrative adjustment in the amount of one or more partnership-related items for any partnership taxable year.

tree.heading: Adjustment
tree.text: Any such adjustment under subsection (a) shall be determined and taken into account for the partnership taxable year in which the administrative adjustment request is filed— In the case of an adjustment that would not result in an imputed underpayment, paragraph (1) shall not apply and paragraph (2) shall apply with appropriate adjustments.

children.text: by the partnership under rules similar to the rules of section 6225 (other than paragraphs (2), (7), and (9) of subsection (c) thereof) for the partnership taxable year in which the administrative adjustment request is filed, or
by the partnership and partners under rules similar to the rules of section 6226 (determined without regard to the substitution described in subsection (c)(2)(C) thereof).

tree.heading: Period of limitations
tree.text: A partnership may not file such a request more than 3 years after the later of— In no event may a partnership file such a request after a notice of an administrative proceeding with respect to the taxable year is mailed under section 6231.

children.text: the date on which the partnership return for such year is filed, or
the last day for filing the partnership return for such year (determined without regard to extensions).

tree.heading: Coordination with adjustments related to foreign tax credits
tree.text: The Secretary shall issue regulations or other guidance which provide for the proper coordination of this section and section 905(c).
